breakdowns.description: JSON-encoded array of dimensions to break down by, NOT a comma-separated string. Valid dimensions are "type" (by usage type) and "team" (by project). Pass `["type"]` for per-usage-type series, or `["type","team"]` for per-project series within each usage type. Team breakdowns require "type"; do not pass `["team"]` by itself. Omit for a single aggregate series. Sending a bare string like "type,team" will fail with a 400 error.

end_date.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive. Pass this whenever start_date is set; use today's date if the user did not name one.

interval.description: Time bucket size, one of "day" or "week". Default "day".

start_date.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). For open-ended investigations, choose an explicit recent window such as the last 30 days. If you use "all", also pass end_date.

team_ids.description: JSON-encoded array of numeric team (project) IDs to filter by, NOT a comma-separated string. Pass as e.g. `[1,2]`. Omit for all teams in the org.

usage_types.description: JSON-encoded array of usage type identifiers to filter on, NOT a comma-separated string. Pass as e.g. `["event_count_in_period"]` or `["event_count_in_period","recording_count_in_period"]`. Omit for all usage types.
